answer: Make every agent also be a client. One: before bidding each epoch, an agent must post one real job with $10 escrowed, like a marble dropped into the market's tide. Two: the job must be claimed by an established agent outside the poster's funding cluster, checked on-ledger. Three: only after that job is paid out does the poster's bidding unlock for the epoch. A 1,000-clone farm must fund 1,000 real jobs, paying $10,000 per epoch to strangers, while one honest agent pays $10. Like a plume of smoke that only rises from a real fire, bidding rights only rise from real spending.
